project1OverviewTitle: A multi-use commercial complex built for long-term performance
project1OverviewBody: S&PA delivered electro-mechanical contracting and maintenance support for a multi-use commercial development in Mansoura. The project focused on reliable system integration, clean installation standards, and readiness for continuous operation after handover.
project1ScopeTitle: Complete MEP package with post-handover maintenance support
project1ScopeBody: Our scope covered mechanical, electrical, and plumbing coordination across the commercial complex, including installation quality control, commissioning support, and professional maintenance planning to protect system performance over time.
project2OverviewTitle: Integrated delivery for a high-rise commercial tower
project2OverviewBody: For Heliopolis Tower, S&PA combined MEP contracting, facility management readiness, and ICT infrastructure in one coordinated package. The result is a high-rise workplace designed for operational continuity and modern connectivity.
project2ScopeTitle: MEP, facility systems, and digital infrastructure under one delivery model
project2ScopeBody: We coordinated electro-mechanical works with structured ICT pathways and facility operation requirements, ensuring design intent was preserved through installation, testing, and early operational support.
project3OverviewTitle: Mission-critical infrastructure for a secure data facility
project3OverviewBody: Cairo Data Center demanded precise power, cooling coordination, and ICT infrastructure. S&PA supported a secure environment where uptime, redundancy, and disciplined installation quality are non-negotiable.
project3ScopeTitle: Power, cooling coordination, and ICT readiness for continuous operation
project3ScopeBody: Our teams delivered infrastructure packages tailored to mission-critical environments — aligning MEP systems with ICT pathways, supporting commissioning, and enabling professional maintenance after go-live.
project4OverviewTitle: Facility programs that keep government workplaces running
project4OverviewBody: At the New Administrative Capital, S&PA provides facility management and maintenance programs for workplace buildings where reliability, compliance, and service continuity matter every day.
project4ScopeTitle: Operations planning with preventive and corrective maintenance
project4ScopeBody: Scope included facility operations support, preventive maintenance routines, and responsive technical coverage designed to protect assets and keep government workplaces performing to standard.
project5OverviewTitle: Complex MEP and facility works for aviation support
project5OverviewBody: Airport environments require disciplined execution and resilient systems. S&PA delivered MEP and facility works for a support facility where safety, uptime, and operational clarity are essential.
project5ScopeTitle: Electro-mechanical delivery with facility readiness for aviation operations
project5ScopeBody: We executed coordinated MEP installation and facility support scopes, ensuring systems were commissioned for demanding aviation-adjacent operations and prepared for ongoing maintenance.
project6OverviewTitle: Secure fit-out infrastructure for a banking headquarters
project6OverviewBody: Bank Headquarters Fit-Out required secure ICT infrastructure and dependable electro-mechanical systems. S&PA delivered a coordinated package suited to high-security banking workplaces.
project6ScopeTitle: ICT pathways and MEP works for secure, high-performance workplaces
project6ScopeBody: Our scope covered structured ICT infrastructure alongside electro-mechanical installation, with careful coordination for security zones, reliability, and clean handover standards.
project7OverviewTitle: Healthcare environments that demand reliable engineering support
project7OverviewBody: Hospital Complex Upgrade brought together MEP contracting with facility and maintenance support. The focus was operational continuity for a healthcare environment where systems cannot afford downtime.
project7ScopeTitle: MEP delivery with facility and maintenance coverage for healthcare operations
project7ScopeBody: We supported electro-mechanical upgrades and facility readiness, aligning installation quality with preventive maintenance so clinical and support areas remain dependable after handover.
project8OverviewTitle: Digital infrastructure expansion for a telecom operations hub
project8OverviewBody: Telecom Hub Expansion focused on resilient digital infrastructure and maintenance services for a growing operations hub. S&PA supported connectivity-ready spaces built for continuous network operations.
project8ScopeTitle: ICT infrastructure with professional maintenance for telecom uptime
project8ScopeBody: Scope included ICT infrastructure installation and post-delivery maintenance support, ensuring the hub remained ready for growth while protecting installed systems through professional care.
